name: Paper bat

purpose.for: The children on Sakura Street's Halloween walk and the shopkeepers who decorate for it
purpose.why: Sakura Shōten has supplied the town's decorations since Mrs Kinjō retired; black-card bats hung between the lanterns make the walk's string read as Halloween from down the street, lit or dark
purpose.where: Hung on cotton threads from the lantern string along Sakura Shōten's awning, between the paper pumpkin lanterns, from 24 to 31 October

notes: Cut by hand from 1 mm black card at Sakura Shōten: a round head with two pointed ears, wings scalloped between the finger points, two white hole-punch dots for eyes with marker pupils, creased down the middle so each wing stands 14 degrees forward. 24 cm across. Built in Blender from a script (site: johansson-town/assets/catalog/halloween-paper-bat/source/build-halloween-paper-bat.py); the Pocket Camera's Halloween sticker is rendered from the same builder (tools/blender/render-halloween-stickers.py). Frame: the back of the crease is z = 0 (the least z), the eyes face +z, lowest point y = 0. Anchors: hang (the thread's pinhole at the top of the crease), balance (the card's centre of mass: hung from hang it settles with balance straight below), eyes, the wing tips. The collider is the bat's own box (auto): it hangs above the walkway at the awning's edge, out of the residents' way; nothing walks into it.
